Container.Name: breakfix-postgres
Container.Overview: PostgreSQL 15 database for BreakFix Triage. Runs on the default Docker bridge network and publishes port 5432 on the Unraid host so the breakfix-triage app container can reach it via the host IP.
Container.Requires: Port 5432 on the Unraid host must be free. If another container already uses 5432, remap the host side to something else (e.g. 5433) and update the app container's DATABASE_URL to match.

Config.Name: Postgres Port
Config.Description: Host port to publish Postgres on. Leave at 5432 unless something else on Unraid already uses it.

Config.Name: Postgres Data
Config.Description: Where Postgres stores its data on the Unraid array. Do not change after the first start unless you also migrate the data directory.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_DB
Config.Description: Database name. Must match the database in the app container's DATABASE_URL.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_USER
Config.Description: Database user. Must match the app container's DATABASE_URL.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Database password. Choose a long random string WITHOUT shell-special characters (@ : / ? #). Must match the password encoded in the app container's DATABASE_URL.
